subject.title: [Feature]: Alibaba Model Studio Token Plan (Team Edition) provider

question: Should OpenClaw accept Alibaba Model Studio Token Plan as a first-class qwen provider/auth surface in the official qwen plugin, or route it outside core/plugin ownership for now?
rationale: This is a new provider id, env var, auth-choice, model-catalog, and outbound-host contract rather than a bug fix, and repository policy treats provider/config surface as compatibility-sensitive product direction.

options.title: Accept bundled qwen Token Plan provider
options.body: Review and unblock the linked PR so the official qwen plugin owns the Token Plan onboarding and catalog surface.

options.title: Route to external plugin first
options.body: Ask for Token Plan support to live as a separate plugin/ClawHub package until maintainers want another official Alibaba provider contract.

options.title: Reject the provider direction
options.body: Close the issue and linked PR if maintainers do not want to support this Alibaba plan as an OpenClaw-owned provider surface.

recommendation.title: Accept bundled qwen Token Plan provider
recommendation.body: Review and unblock the linked PR so the official qwen plugin owns the Token Plan onboarding and catalog surface.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter Steinberger is the strongest available history signal for the qwen provider/plugin surface that the request extends.
